Die Spur läuft etwa 4 % zu schnell. Desh: The track runs about 4 % too fast. That's why it fits at the start and then drifts further and further apart. This is typical for versions from European TV and DVDs (PAL): there, films run at 25 instead of 24 frames per second, which makes picture and sound faster and voices a little higher.
Die Spur läuft etwa 4 % zu langsam. Verm: The track runs about 4 % too slow. The video probably comes from a PAL version at 25 frames per second and the track from a cinema or Blu-ray version at 24 frames per second.
The track runs 0.1 % too {direction}. This happens between 24 and 23.976 frames per second (NTSC) and adds up to about 7 seconds over a two-hour film.
